settings.text: Do not expose all crystals to water, as some may dissolve or get damaged.
Do not leave crystals in direct sunlight for too long, as some may fade.
Do not drop or roughly handle crystals to avoid breaking them.
Do not mix all crystals together, as some may affect each other’s energy.
Do not forget to recharge your crystals to maintain their energy.
Store your crystals in a safe, dry place as the S-Brillet drawstring box to keep their energy pure.
Cleanse your crystals regularly using water, moonlight, or sound.
Handle your crystals gently to avoid cracks.
Use crystals with intention, whether for meditation, energy work, or decoration.
Research your crystals to understand their unique properties and care needs.

settings.heading: Jewelry & Crystal Care Guide
settings.description: Taking care of your jewelry and crystals ensures their beauty and energy last a lifetime.
